about: The behaviour of the game camera on the camera entity of the client: what it follows (Targets), where its look-at point is going and is (TargetDestination, TargetCurrent), its distance going and current, whether it is gliding (MovingToTarget) and whether the player has taken it (PlayerInControl). A write of Targets and TargetDestination moves the camera in and out of a fight. The set at +0x208 and the two optional points at +0x238 and +0x248 hold a cut behind a black screen that is pending. Script Extender: GameCameraBehavior.

evidence.says: the header Components/Camera.h of Script Extender binds GameCameraBehavior to this engine name and declares the fields; the offsets are from its layout (gatekit symbols layout)

on the level Basic_Level_A one client entity carries it, with Camera, CameraTarget, CameraCombatTarget, CameraCombatTargetRequests, CameraSelectorMode, DefaultCameraBehavior and EffectCameraBehavior; at rest Targets holds one entity, TargetCurrent equals TargetDestination to a hair, DistanceCurrent and DistanceDestination read 10, MovingToTarget, PlayerInControl, IsSnapping and AtLeashLimit read false, the byte at +0x200 reads 1 and both optional points are empty

the registry entry of ecl::CameraSystem::SnapFade reads +0x24 and +0x48 as the destination and current target, the set at +0x208 as the filed fade request and +0x248 (flag +0x254) and +0x238 (flag +0x244) as the pending target and destination; not read again here
